params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date for the time-frame window (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for the time-frame window (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: source
params.description:
Three-letter ISO 4217 source/base currency code. Defaults to USD on the Free
plan; any source currency may be selected on Basic plan and above.

params.name: currencies
params.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 currency codes to limit the result set.

items.docs:
Returns daily historical exchange rates between two dates of your choice,
with a maximum range of 365 days. Available on Enterprise plan and above.
